title: William John Gibson
dates: (b. Peshawur 1853)
---

clerk

He married (1883) Emmeline Spratt.

He was a clerk in a City of London warehouse in the 1881 census.

He may or may not be the dissenting ‘clerk and of a station rather above, much given to good works’ to whom she was engaged in 1878.
